Step 1: Installation
Downloading the ISO To begin, visit the official Omarchy website [https://omarchy.org/] (https://omarchy.org/ and download the latest version of the ISO. Ensure you choose the correct version for your system architecture (e.g., x86_64).
Writing the ISO to a USB Drive Use a tool like balenaEtcher [https://www.balena.io/etcher/] (https://www.balena.io/etcher/ to write the downloaded ISO to a USB drive. Insert your USB drive and select it as the target device in Etcher. Click "Flash!" to begin the process.
Disabling Secure Boot/TPM Before proceeding with installation, you need to disable Secure Boot and TPM in your BIOS settings. Restart your computer, enter the BIOS by pressing the appropriate key (usually F2, Del, or Esc), and navigate to the security settings. Disable Secure Boot and TPM, then save and exit.

Step 2: Accessing Core Features
Application Launcher (Super + Space) The Super + Space hotkey opens Walker, a search and open application tool. Simply type the name of the application you want to launch, and Walker will display relevant results. This feature enhances productivity by allowing quick access to applications without navigating through menus.
Omarchy Menu (Super + Alt + Space) Pressing Super + Alt + Space brings up the central hub for system updates, hardware triggers, and software installs. Here, you can manage your system's configuration, install new packages, and perform other essential tasks with ease.
Open Terminal (Super + Enter) To open a terminal window, press Super + Enter. Omarchy preconfigures either Alacritty or Ghosty as the default terminal emulator. These terminals offer advanced features like GPU acceleration and smooth scrolling, making them ideal for developers working on complex projects.
Close Window (Super + W) Closing windows is straightforward with Super + W. Simply press this hotkey while focused on the window you want to close, and it will be removed from your desktop. localhost:7000/api/research/report/rp-19fe28b2b68d

Step 3: Managing Workspaces
Switch Focus (Super + Arrow Keys) Navigating between open applications is made easy with Super + Arrow Keys. Pressing these keys cycles through windows in a circular manner, allowing you to quickly switch focus without using the mouse.
Send Apps to Different Workspaces (Super + Shift + [1-9]) To organize your work environment, use Super + Shift + [1-9] to send applications to different workspaces. This feature enhances productivity by allowing you to dedicate specific workspaces for different tasks or projects.
Toggle Fullscreen Modes (Super + F and Super + Alt + F) Omarchy offers two fullscreen modes: absolute fullscreen with Super + F and full-width mode while preserving the status bar with Super + Alt + F. These hotkeys provide flexibility in how you use your screen space, ensuring that you can focus on tasks without distractions.
Power Menu (Super + Escape) For system management, press Super + Escape to access the power menu. This feature allows you to lock your session, suspend your computer, or initiate a shutdown with ease. The power menu ensures that you have quick access to essential system functions without leaving your current workspace.

To keep your system up-to-date and synchronized with the latest configurations, run Update > Omarchy from the central menu. This feature automates the process of pulling the latest configurations, migrating dotfiles safely, and keeping your system packages synchronized via the Omarchy Repository.

Step 5: System Customization & Dotfiles
Theming (Super + Ctrl + Shift + Space and Super + Ctrl + Space) Omarchy comes with 19 curated visual themes. Switch between them using Super + Ctrl + Shift + Space or cycle background wallpapers instantly with Super + Ctrl + Space. This feature allows you to personalize your desktop environment without cluttering system defaults.
Config Management (Setup > Configs in Neovim) To avoid changing files directly in ~/.local/share/omarchy, edit settings via Setup > Configs in the menu. Neovim opens the file, and exiting the text editor automatically reloads the relevant system service (like Waybar or Walker). This approach ensures that your customizations are managed safely and efficiently.

Omarchy Skill for AI Coding Agents Omarchy features an experimental Omarchy Skill built for AI coding agents like Claude Code. Step 7: Developer & Productivity Tools
Built-in Reminders (omarchy reminder and Super + Ctrl + R) Set quick notification timers by running omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready' in the CLI or pressing Super + Ctrl + R. This feature helps you stay on track with important tasks and deadlines without constantly checking your calendar.
Isolated Windows VM Run Windows-specific apps like Microsoft Office safely using a local Docker VM container. Install it through the menu; it isolates Windows from your primary Linux directories except for a shared sandbox folder at ~/Windows. This feature ensures that you can use Windows applications without compromising your Linux environment.
Terminal Multi-plexing (Super + Alt + Return) Seamlessly use Tmux via Super + Alt + Return with an optimized keybinding set configured natively to use Ctrl + Space as its primary prefix. This feature enhances productivity by allowing you to manage multiple terminal sessions within a single window.
Fullscreen Modes (Super + F and Super + Alt + F) As mentioned earlier, toggle fullscreen modes with Super + F for absolute fullscreen or Super + Alt + F for full-width mode while preserving the status bar. These hotkeys provide flexibility in how you use your screen space, ensuring that you can focus on tasks without distractions.
